plan: In a first-price sealed bid auction with independent private values, the optimal strategy is to bid strategically below my true value. With a private value of $27, I'll bid slightly under that to maximize potential profit. Since I don't know other bidders' values, I'll aim to win while leaving some potential profit margin. A bid around $24-$25 seems reasonable to increase my chances of winning while protecting my potential earnings.

With a private value of $31, my optimal strategy is to bid slightly below my true value. This protects my potential profit margin. Since values are drawn independently and randomly between $0-$49, other bidders might have similar or different valuations. I'll bid $30.10 - just under my true value but close enough to have a good chance of winning while minimizing overpayment risk. This allows potential profit if I win and minimizes loss if I don't.

With a private value of $20, my optimal strategy is to bid strategically near my value. Since this is a second-price sealed bid auction, I want to bid close to my true value to maximize potential profit. I'll bid slightly above my value to increase my winning chances, but not so high that I risk negative profit. A bid around $22-$23 seems reasonable to balance winning probability and potential earnings.
